notes: On 11 September 2021, a Zamfara militias attacked a security forces base in Dan Sadau (Maru, Zamfara). Twelve security personnel, including military and police officers, were killed.

On 6 February 2024, soldiers attacked policemen at their camp in Sabon Gari area of Mangu (Mangu, Plateau). An unspecified number of policemen were wounded, and they claimed that the attack was unprovoked.

Around 30 September 2021 (week of), an unidentified cult group killed four suspected members of a rival group in Kuchibena, near the Life Camp, Abuja (Abuja Municipal, FCT). The assailants dismembered the body of one of their victims, chopped off his head and hung it on a stick. The community had been in palpable fear over the incessant cult clashes and killing in the area, prompting the police to request that the slums in the area be demolished. 4 fatalities reported.

On 18 December 2023, an unidentified armed group killed the police orderly of a high court judge, then proceeded to abduct the judge and her driver as they were traveling along Okobo axis of Oron-Uyo road (Oron, Akwa Ibom). The assailants had posed as a local defense militia on the road. The abductees were released on 23 December, there are no reports on ransom payment.
On 27 May 2020, communal militias from Urum and Achalla clashed over a parcel of land in Urum (Awka North LGA, Anambra). 1 person was killed and several were reported injured.
On 23 August 2023, the Nigerian military shot and killed four ISWAP fighters in Pulka (Gwoza, Borno) and Firgi, coded separately. Fatalities split across two locations, 2 coded.

On 17 January 2023, an unidentified armed group shot and killed an inspector of police while patrolling Iheorji Ohanku Road, Aba (Aba South, Abia). The police shot and killed two militiamen and others escaped with gun wounds. The militiamen carted away an AK-47 rifle belonging to the deceased officer. 3 fatalities reported.

On 10 July 2024, an unidentified armed group shot and killed an OSPAC member in the Igwuruta community (Ikwerre, Rivers). The group was responding to a distress call concerning an abduction case when its members were ambushed, and one got shot and killed.

On 5 December 2022, a Sokoto militia numbering about 90 killed three policemen guarding a market and three civilians when they attacked Yar Bulutu market in Sabon Birni LGA (Sokoto) and shot sporadically. The assailants set one of the policemen's vehicle ablaze and threw the body of one policeman into the fire, several other civilians sustained varying bullet wounds.
